details: Geopolitical tensions between the United States and Iran have eased, with reports confirming a temporary halt in military hostilities. This development has led to a notable drop in oil prices, easing concerns about inflation and encouraging a return to riskier assets. As a result, cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin have seen upward momentum, holding above $65,000, and Ethereum is approaching the $2,000 mark.
title: Easing US-Iran Tensions Boost Crypto Markets

details: Bitcoin is maintaining its position above $65,000 as investor attention shifts from recent geopolitical headlines to the upcoming US Federal Reserve interest rate decision (July 28-29). While the easing of US-Iran tensions has positively influenced sentiment, the market remains cautious. The Fed's stance on inflation and future monetary policy will be a critical factor in determining short-term market direction for cryptocurrencies.
title: Bitcoin Stabilizes Ahead of Federal Reserve Rate Decision

details: The continuous growth of the US federal debt, recently hitting an all-time high of $39.7 trillion, is leading some investors to turn to limited-supply assets like Bitcoin and gold. This "debasement trade" reflects a belief that fiat currencies may decline in value due to high government indebtedness, suggesting a long-term constructive outlook for these digital and precious assets as stores of value.
title: Rising US Debt Prompts Bitcoin and Gold as Devaluation Hedge

details: The Digital Asset Market Clarity (CLARITY) Act is moving through the US Senate, with a potential vote anticipated in the first week of August. This legislative progress, aimed at providing regulatory clarity for digital assets, is generating optimism within the cryptocurrency market and is seen as crucial for fostering greater institutional trust and adoption in the US.
title: CLARITY Act Progress Bolsters US Crypto Market Optimism
